name: Policy Text Lab
description: Policy Text Lab is a full-stack platform for computational text research, supporting corpus management, human annotation, reliability analysis, quantitative analysis, supervised classification, topic modeling, and reproducible exports. Built with a modular FastAPI backend and React frontend, backed by PostgreSQL with pgvector, Redis, and Celery workers. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
